verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a tax and customs services portal, since such portals could offer batch submissions or multi-taxpayer actions. Nothing in the evidence pack documents doing anything in bulk. The items cover single-user services: notification enrollment, communication channels, parcel customs lookups, login, and a services area for certified accountants.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
